question: Was a dedicated Civic Hall calendar listing or event-detail page preserved for the January 2016 New York City Council constituent-services hackathon?
method: Wayback CDX enumeration and event-prefix review
recovered: New York City Council event-day post
finding: No dedicated Civic Hall calendar listing or event-detail page was recovered in the documented search.
publicSummary: No dedicated Civic Hall event page was recovered in this research pass. The surviving Civic Hall site evidence comes from an embedded social feed.
limitations: Absence from the recovered capture set is not proof that a page never existed.
The embedded feed is archival site evidence, not a recovered calendar listing.
The RSVP form is unavailable and no archived copy was recovered.
